text:
maria.garcia: heads-up — compliance asked for a one-click download of the admin change trail (who changed what + reason + source ip) for legal requests. they want csv and ndjson options, and a short retention note :wave:
kevin.lee: we can already stream ndjson from the changefeed, but need to decide on actor resolution and pii redaction rules. also presigned link vs console modal download?
sachin: +1 on presigned. big tenants will want S3 presigned links they can ingest. need expiry policy (shorter for admin exports).
olivia: console ux question — do we put download next to the timeline or in a compliance panel? i'd prefer a compact "Download evidence" CTA on the timeline row for privileged changes.
maria.garcia: timeline CTA makes sense for quick pulls. compliance also wants scheduled bundles (daily/weekly) for longer ranges.
kevin.lee: biggest open: what fields do we include by default? actor (display name + id), action, timestamp, diff, justification, ip, user_agent. we should let admins toggle extras.
sachin: need to bake in redaction modes: none / pseudonymize / redact. pseudonymize = hashed actor id, but preserve mapping for tenant owner. redact should strip ip/user_agent.
olivia: telemetry ask from security: record who requested the export + query params (range, fields) for auditability. those should show up in the audit of audits.
kevin.lee: quotas — exports are heavy. propose per-tenant export quota (tokens) + cooldown. also async job queue with priority for enterprise plans.
maria.garcia: legal wants the exported CSV to include the justification text if present. that may be long; CSV should quote properly or we offer ndjson as canonical.
sachin: implementation sketch:

```
POST /api/v1/audit/exports
body: { tenant: "acme", from: "2026-02-01", to: "2026-03-01", format: "ndjson", fields: ["actor","action","diff","reason","ip"], redact: "pseudonymize" }
```

response: job id, presigned_url when ready

olivia: UX for small ranges: instant modal. large ranges >100k lines -> queued job + email/presigned link. show remaining quota and estimated time.

kevin.lee: rollout plan: feature flag gated. canary to internal orgs -> beta customers -> open. metric to watch: export CPU/IO, S3 egress, and "time-to-first-byte" for downloads.

maria.garcia: compliance also demands an "export provenance" header in the bundle with job id, who requested it, and a signed digest for forensic integrity.
auditsvc: [bot] export-job-6135791234 started for tenant=acme (redact=pseudonymize)

sachin: signing the bundle is straightforward — include a manifest.json with job metadata and sha256s for each file. we should also sign the manifest with our key.

kevin.lee: edge case: merges/rollbacks — if a change was reverted, compliance wants both entries (change + revert) and a pointer to snapshot state. include "revert_of" where applicable.
olivia: small copy note for console: explain pseudonymize vs redact inline, and show examples. legal folks appreciated examples last time.
maria.garcia: can someone prototype the API shape + console mock tomorrow? kevin/sachin? i'll surface to compliance after the prototype.
kevin.lee: i'll sketch API and queue behaviour. sachin will take signing/redaction paths.
sachin: ack. i'll add tests for redaction modes and sampling heuristics (if tenant chooses sample exports).

maria.garcia: thanks — also open question: should exports be discoverable via the telemetry api for billing? finance wants to avoid surprises.
kevin.lee: include export bytes & job runtime in billing telemetry. gate high-cost jobs behind billing check for orgs without committed spend.

olivia: will add console copy + CTA placement and a mock of the queued job modal.

maria.garcia: awesome. follow-ups: kevin/sachin to drop a PR+api spec by EOD tomorrow, olivia will attach mocks in this thread. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: scheduled job audit-compact-cleanup ran at 2026-03-11T02:00:01Z

maria.garcia: noted. tagging legal and compliance to review once we have PR.
